$description: Fume UI tokens (semantic layer). DECIDED 13 Oct 2026 (approved on the review board, F-D072 to F-D075), first shown in round 6, 13 Oct 2026. Every value points at a brand primitive in tokens/fume-tokens.json ({fume.<name>}) or uses alpha({fume.<name>}, a). Components use only these tokens (--ui-*), never primitives or literal values. Build: node tools/tokens/build.mjs
$principles: Calm ground, sharp decisions: Porcelain carries the page, Paper lies behind it, Ink makes the decisions.
States come into focus: on light surfaces hover moves one step toward Ink on the Focus ramp and pressed moves two; on glass, hover lifts the veil one step and pressed returns.
Floating layers are Smoke glass (DECIDED 13 Oct): no stroke, a soft Ink shadow under the glass, no shadow on the buttons that sit on it.

As few strokes as possible. Separate with surface, depth and space, never with lines: a sidebar sits behind the page, not beside it behind a hairline. A hairline only where an element would otherwise vanish (inputs, the white secondary button, the edge of the customer's creative).
GT Standard for all UI. GT Canon only for marketing titles (website, posts, decks).
Pills for actions (DECIDED 12 Oct), soft rectangles for content. Rows in a menu fill the menu edge to edge.
Touch is first class: every target is at least 44 px (--ui-size-hit), a tap shows the pressed state and never the browser's grey flash, and hover exists only where there is a mouse.

Air before ornament: every surface keeps its inset (--ui-inset-*), so text never crowds an edge or sits in a corner's curve. Padding, margins and gaps come from the space and inset tokens, never from loose numbers.
High end: fewer, larger, quieter things. Every element earns its place; nothing is decorative.

Warmth is light, not fill (rounds 10 and 11): Paper behind the page and under the first run, Cream for people, full Amber for checked work; no beige surfaces. Shimmer text is white light through dark words, the Engine's too (Amber shimmer taken out 15 Oct). Ink still makes every decision.

ground-warm.description: Whole sections only, never two in a row.

surface.description: Cards and grouped content on Porcelain. A card never matches its ground.

surface-sunken-hover.description: Hover on a sunken surface (a switch track, a sunken badge): one step toward Ink. PROPOSED, round 7.

surface-creative.description: Pure white: only the customer's creative, inputs and the secondary button, always with a hairline (one of the few places a stroke is allowed).

hairline.description: Only where an element would otherwise vanish: input edges, the white secondary button, the edge of the customer's creative. Never between regions, panels, rows or a sidebar and the page (rule few-strokes).

hairline-strong.description: Input edges on hover, secondary button on hover.

focus-ring.description: Keyboard focus: a sharp 2px Ink ring, 2px off the edge. Never a soft halo.

check.description: The Amber check. The checked triangle on work an expert has checked (each checked creative carries one), or a point beside a label. Never a fill, a button, text or an area bigger than a chip.

check-waiting.description: The checked triangle on work that is still in check: the same shape as the Amber check, in grey (Marcus 13 Oct: Amber only when checked; the expert checks, only the customer approves). Always beside a text label, so colour is never the only signal.

selection.description: Text selection highlight: a neutral grey under Ink text. Round 13 (Marcus 21 Oct, #37: "Feil tekst markerings farge"; PROPOSED): Amber 100 read as checked, and Amber only means checked by an expert.

selection-on-glass.description: Text selection on Smoke glass: a light veil under the light glass text. Round 13 (#37; PROPOSED).

selected.description: Light on what you chose: a selected row, a date range. A faint wash of Amber, 10 % over the ground (#FEF4E9 on Porcelain), never full Amber and never a button; the control that chose it (the checkbox, the ends of the range) stays Ink. Round 10 (Marcus 13 Oct: Amber 50 was too much here); round 9 had Amber 50, round 8 Focus 100. The other candidate, Focus 100, is under $options.selection.

depth-near.description: Contact shadow for raised surfaces on light ground.

depth-far.description: Soft spread shadow for raised surfaces on light ground.

ground-behind.description: The layer behind the page: app sidebars and rails sit on it, and the page lies on top as a Porcelain sheet. Paper, the warm ground the work lies on (DECIDED: Marcus chose Warmer, 13 Oct, round 9; round 8 had Focus 100). No stroke between them. Tertiary text 5.5:1.

behind-hover.description: Rows on the layer behind (sidebar navigation): hover, one step warmer, Cream (DECIDED with Warmer, 13 Oct; round 8 had Focus 200). Tertiary text 4.9:1.

behind-active.description: The current place in the sidebar comes forward to the page's own Porcelain, lifted with depth-raised.

danger.description: Rouge (Marcus, 13 Oct 2026, F-D067). Delete and errors. Paper label 4.7:1, as text on Porcelain 4.9:1.

danger-hover.description: One step toward Ink. Paper label 5.7:1.

state-ready.description: PROPOSED 22 Oct 2026 (round 13, Marcus #39): Moss, the colour of ready. The label and dot of a Ready or Delivered badge, never anything else. 5.4:1 on its ground, 6.2:1 on Porcelain.

state-ready-ground.description: PROPOSED with state-ready: the light ground of a Ready or Delivered badge.

primary-pressed.description: Returns to Ink; the press is carried by scale.

secondary.description: White: the second button, with a hairline.

bg.description: Smoke (Marcus, 13 Oct 2026: Smoke, a little lighter). Ink at 28 % over a softened, dimmed backdrop: neutral warm grey, lighter and clearer than round 3.

bg-solid.description: Fallback when blur is unsupported or transparency is reduced: solid Ink, never solid Brown.

fg-secondary.description: Secondary text on glass, weight 500. 5.4:1 over the worst backdrop (a white page). Never thinner or fainter.

scrim.description: Dims the page behind a modal (dim to focus).

button-white.description: White button: the main action on glass. At least 90 % white so it reads solid. Ink label, 15:1. No shadow.

button-white-pressed.description: Sinks a little, with the 3 % shrink.

button-clear.description: Clear button: a faint Porcelain veil, so it is visibly there without a shadow or a stroke. Porcelain label 5.0:1 over the worst backdrop. Secondary actions on glass.

button-clear-hover.description: Lifts one step. Porcelain label 4.6:1 over the worst backdrop.

button-clear-pressed.description: Returns to rest, with the 3 % shrink.

button-danger.description: Coloured buttons on glass have their own transparency: the colour at 80 %, so the glass shows through (Marcus 13 Oct). Danger is the only coloured button; Amber is never one. Porcelain label. No shadow, no stroke.

button-danger-pressed.description: Returns to rest, with the 3 % shrink.

button-disabled.description: Disabled button on glass, either variant.

item-hover.description: Menu rows on glass: hover and keyboard highlight. The row fills the menu edge to edge.

field.description: Text fields on glass. No stroke; focus shows the ring. Label 4.8:1.

filter.description: Smoke, lighter: the backdrop is softened (contrast 0.65) so dark images lift and light pages stay readable. Over a white page Porcelain text is 6.3:1, secondary text 5.4:1.

filter-small.description: Small glass (tooltips, chips): the same material, thinner blur.

shadow.description: Under the glass only: offset, Ink-tinted. No glow, no stroke, never on the buttons.

raised.description: A surface lifted a little off its ground (the selected pill in a segmented control, a popover handle). Replaces a hairline.

sheet.description: The page as a sheet lying on the layer behind it (ground-behind). Replaces the stroke between a sidebar and the page.

action.description: Pill: buttons, chips, badges, segmented controls, toolbars. DECIDED 12 Oct 2026 (Marcus).

item.description: Rows in lists on light surfaces. Menu rows on glass have no radius of their own: they fill the menu and its corners clip them.

check.description: Checkboxes: a 20 px box with a soft corner, half the field radius, so it keeps the softness of a field without turning into a circle. PROPOSED, round 7.

float.description: Menus, selects, popovers and tooltips: floating glass that is not a dialog. Rounder than cards. DECIDED 13 Oct 2026 (Marcus chose Rounder).

panel.description: Dialogs, sheets, large glass panels. DECIDED 13 Oct 2026 (Marcus chose Rounder).

space.$description: Spacing on the 4 px grid, for gaps and margins in components. Padding inside a surface uses the inset tokens below.

xs.description: 4px. Between a label and its hint.

sm.description: 8px. Icon to label in buttons; between buttons in a row.

md.description: 12px. Icon to label in menu rows; between a title and its text.

xl.description: 24px. Between a dialog's text and its buttons.

inset.$description: Padding inside a surface: the air between its edge and what it holds. At least three quarters of the surface's corner radius, so nothing sits in the curve. Gate rule air; measured on the rendered board in CI.

panel.description: 24px. Dialogs, sheets and glass panels with text (radius.panel 32).

float.description: 16px. Popovers, cards and toasts with text, and sideways in menu and list rows (radius.float 22).

tight.description: 12px. Sideways in tooltips and small glass labels.

ring.description: The even gap between a pill bar and the pills inside it, so the inner pill follows the outer one.

seg.description: Gap between a segmented track and its white pill. Round 6 choice: inset (3px) or fill (0, the pill fills the track); see $options.segmented.

family.description: GT Standard. The only UI face.

family-data.description: GT Standard Mono: timestamps, sizes, codes, keyboard keys. Never as decoration.

display.description: 52px, GT Canon, weight 500, -0.02em. Marketing titles only (the brand book's page titles, the website, decks); never in the product. Each use marks gate-allow:canon-not-in-ui.

display-hero.description: 72px, GT Canon, weight 400, -0.02em. The one title that leads the first view of a web page (kit/web.css .web-display--hero). Marketing only; each use marks gate-allow:canon-not-in-ui.

display-small.description: 32px, GT Canon. Marketing titles on a phone (under 760 px), so a title keeps to three or four lines at 390 px (kit/web.css).

display-family.description: GT Canon (Newsreader stands in on trial licences). Only with --ui-type-display, for marketing titles; the gate flags every use (canon-not-in-ui) so each one is marked.

seg.description: Height of a segmented track (tabs, filters). The options are this minus twice inset.seg.

hit.description: The smallest touch target (Apple HIG 44 pt, WCAG 2.5.5). A control may look smaller (32 px small buttons, 30 px tab pills) but its hit area is never under this.

icon-stroke.description: Line-only icons (check, plus, x, arrows, search). Every other icon is filled (DECIDED 13 Oct). Built in design-system/icons.

enter-blur.description: Glass arrives from blur to sharp.

spin.description: One turn of the loading spinner.

slide.description: Tabs and segmented controls: the selection slides to the new option. Easing gets its own round.
